inscription-materials-ah-price-guide.htm.intro_description: Every row below is an actual tradeable item that can be posted on the Auction House. Each price band was audited from the exact 3.3.5 recipe, minimum guaranteed output, this guide set's matching reagent references, and a modest demand-sensitive crafting margin. Prices are per finished item; recheck the live AH before crafting a batch, and do not add a cooldown premium when this server shortens or removes that cooldown.

shared_note.label: Craft-cost pricing

Recheck the live ink, glyph, card, and deck markets before crafting; sell glyphs and scrolls mostly as singles or small stacks.
